text:
Maya P: Noticed several postmortem actions without verifiers. Proposing a 15m weekly "PM follow-up" to triage open items (owner, ETA, blocker). IC on duty facilitates.

Ethan B: 👍 Can we add verifier + category (code/process/infra) fields to the tracker? Makes trend queries easier.

Rita S: Also request automated DM reminders at 7d and 2d before due date. Oncall gets noisy if things linger.

Maya P: Agreed. Plan: 1) Add verifier & category columns; 2) incidents-bot DMs owners; 3) IC rotation will run weekly meeting; 4) monthly trends review for recurring fixes.

Ethan B: I'll draft a 1-page facilitator checklist (how to run 15m, max 8 items, note format) and a sample SQL for monthly heatmap. Due Thu.

Rita S: Volunteers for the IC facilitation rota: Rita, Ethan, Maya. I'm happy to start.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: "PM follow-up" weekly, Mon 09:00-09:15. New columns added to tracker: verifier, category, reminder_schedule.

Maya P: Thanks — if the bot posts a 30m pre-agenda that'd be ideal. I'll set up the calendar once checklist arrives.

Ethan B: Will upload checklist + query link here when ready.

Rita S: +1 on pre-agenda. Keeps meeting tight.

Maya P: OK closing thread; invites & checklist incoming.
